def _git_churn(args):
    import subprocess
    from collections import defaultdict
    from rich.console import Console
    from rich.table import Table

    since = " ".join(args) or "2 days ago"
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "log", f"--since={since}", "--numstat", "--format=author:%an"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    console = Console()
    if result.returncode:
        console.print(result.stderr.strip(), style="red", markup=False)
        return result.returncode

    counts = defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0, 0])
    author = None
    for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("author:"):
            author = line.removeprefix("author:")
            counts[author][0] += 1
        elif author and "\t" in line:
            added, deleted, _ = line.split("\t", 2)
            if added.isdigit() and deleted.isdigit():
                counts[author][1] += int(added)
                counts[author][2] += int(deleted)

    table = Table(title=f"Git churn · since {since}")
    table.add_column("Author")
    for name, style in [
        ("Commits", ""),
        ("Added", "green"),
        ("Deleted", "red"),
        ("Net", "cyan"),
    ]:
        table.add_column(name, justify="right", style=style)

    for author, (commits, added, deleted) in sorted(
        counts.items(), key=lambda item: item[1][1], reverse=True
    ):
        table.add_row(
            author, str(commits), f"{added:,}", f"{deleted:,}",
            f"{added - deleted:+,}",
        )

    console.print(table)

aliases["git-churn"] = _git_churn
